top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.

top_sast_rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-425 forced-browsing direct-request restricted-url protected-route protected-file missing-authorization route endpoint hidden-link
top_sast_rules.remediation: Authorize every protected route and resource on direct access.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check
top_sast_rules.description: Enabling allowRunningInsecureContent can allow remote code execution.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-494. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
top_sast_rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to this vulnerability type. Review the query logic for detailed requirements.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
top_sast_rules.description: Directly sending file data in an outbound network request can indicate unauthorized information disclosure.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find code that may expose sensitive information in error messages, logs, or responses
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper access control checks. Use role-based or attribute-based authorization and validate permissions consistently.

top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive cookies set by a server can be read by the client if the `httpOnly` flag is not set.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Set HttpOnly flag on session cookies to prevent JavaScript access. Also use Secure and SameSite attributes.

top_sast_rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-697 incorrect-comparison equality compare comparator mismatch canonicalization hostname url signature token partial-comparison substring
top_sast_rules.remediation: Compare canonical complete values with the intended security predicate.

top_sast_rules.description: Checking for the "javascript:" URL scheme without also checking for "vbscript:" and "data:" suggests a logic error or even a security vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-184. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
top_sast_rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement loop bounds and timeout mechanisms. Add maximum iteration counts. Use break conditions that cannot be controlled by user input.
